stanza: And take me disappearing through the smoke rings of my mind

Far from the twisted reach of crazy sorrow
Yes, to dance beneath the diamond sky with one hand waving free

stanza: And I have this thought when I lay in bed at night

Careless words melt it away (Melt away)

stanza: And there's too much going on

waves.line: And we lived beneath the waves
stanza: So we sailed on to the sun
